title: 101A Maples Road, Wedgewood, Sandyford, Dublin 16
description:
Ray Cooke Auctioneers are delighted to present this stunning three-bedroom, three-bathroom corner residence to the market at 101A Maples Road, Wedgewood, Sandyford, Dublin 16. Beautifully upgraded throughout and presented in excellent decorative order, this impressive home offers bright, contemporary living accommodation combined with an exceptional south-facing rear garden, a high-spec garden office pod, and superb convenience in one of South Dublin’s most sought-after residential developments.

Nestled within the highly regarded Wedgewood development, No. 101A enjoys a prime corner position with excellent privacy and further scope to extend subject to planning permission. The property has been meticulously maintained and recently enhanced with upgraded bathroom suites, modern kitchen appliances, new flooring, and fresh paint throughout, creating a true turn-key opportunity for discerning buyers.
Extending to approx. 88 sqm of spacious and well-proportioned floorspace, the home comprises of an inviting entrance Porch/hallway, downstairs wc with ample storage, a bright and stylish living area, a modern fitted kitchen and dining space along with a separate utility room. Upstairs hosts three generous double bedrooms (one with ensuite) along with the main family bathroom. The garden of the property is a standout feature, boasting a large private south-facing garden complete with security gates, ideal for outdoor entertaining, family living, or simply relaxing in complete privacy. A high-spec garden office pod and separate storage provide excellent flexibility for remote working, hobbies, or additional storage.

The location of 101A Maples Road is second to none. Situated just a five-minute walk from Kilmacud LUAS, the property benefits from superb connectivity to Dublin City Centre while also enjoying immediate access to the M50 road network. A wealth of amenities are within a short stroll, these include SuperValu, cafés, takeaways, pharmacy, playgrounds and local services, while nearby Beacon South Quarter, Dundrum Town Centre, Marlay Park and Airfield Estate provide endless shopping, dining and recreational opportunities. The area also enjoys a strong sense of community with a nearby farmers market, local GAA club and an active residents’ association, while the Dublin Mountains are within easy reach for outdoor enthusiasts.

The surrounding area is renowned for its highly sought after selection of schools and educational facilities including Naomh Olaf, Mount Anville School, Wesley College, Alexandra College and St. Benildus College, while both UCD and Trinity College are easily accessible.

This exceptional home represents a rare opportunity to acquire a move-in-ready family residence with outstanding outdoor space, excellent transport links and unrivalled convenience in the heart of Sandyford. Early viewing is highly advised—contact Ray Cooke Auctioneers today for further information or to arrange a viewing.

Features
• Stunning 3 bedroom / 3 bathroom corner residence
• BER C2
• C. 88 Sqm of internal floorspace
• Separate utility room for added convenience
• Spacious and modern family home presented in turnkey condition
• Off-street parking for two cars
• Recently upgraded throughout including bathrooms, flooring, appliances and décor
• Prime corner site with potential to extend (subject to planning permission)
• Large private south-facing garden with security gates
• High-spec garden office pod and additional garden shed
• Gas-fired central heating with integrated HIVE system
• Double-glazed windows throughout
• Wired for PhoneWatch alarm system
• Excellent decorative order throughout
• Five minutes’ walk to Kilmacud LUAS
• Close to Beacon South Quarter, Dundrum Town Centre, Marlay Park & Airfield Estate
• Fantastic local amenities within walking distance
• Excellent choice of schools nearby
• Strong community atmosphere with nearby farmers market and GAA club
• Quiet and well-maintained development
• Ideal family home in a highly sought-after South Dublin location
